method: CL/CD: NeuralFoil (XFOIL-trained) for |alpha|<=20 deg; smoothstep to flat-plate deep-stall model for 20<|alpha|<45 deg; flat-plate model beyond. CD(90 deg)~1.7, CD(150 deg)~0.4, CL(120-150 deg)~-0.56, anchored to Sheldahl & Klimas (1981).
cm_method: NeuralFoil CM for |alpha|<=20 deg (quarter-chord, positive nose-up); smoothstep to synthetic Abbott & von Doenhoff trend for 20<|alpha|<45 deg; synthetic trend beyond. Not measured.
cm_convention: Positive Cm is nose-up about the quarter chord, matching the solver's Qa_cm = q*Cm*c term. Negative alpha uses odd symmetry.
note: These tables are not raw experimental data. The attached-flow Cl, Cd and Cm come from an XFOIL-trained surrogate; deep-stall Cl/Cd and the deep-stall Cm are analytic trends.
